clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell's chapel, Aramis Hammerhand trains the newly risen Forsaken in holy combat. The Holy Light can answer their call, but wielding it burns their decayed flesh and demands fierce discipline.

In Deathknell's chapel, Aramis Hammerhand guides Forsaken who hold fast to their former faith. Before the Scourge swept across the north, many people of Lordaeron answered the Silver Hand's call. Aramis survived the fall of Lordaeron, then rose into undeath. He kept the martial and spiritual teachings of his former life, and now guides others who refuse to surrender their devotion.

For the Forsaken, channeling the Holy Light demands fierce will. Its power burns necrotic flesh and stirs long-dead nerves into excruciating pain. Aramis teaches new paladins that faith means enduring that torment. He asks them to face the physical and spiritual costs of wielding a force opposed to their undead nature.
